messages:
Kira: heads-up: rollout r-1150 caused a route reshuffle in us-central at ~11:12. p95 spiked and we saw quota denies. log snippet:

Kira: ```
2026-04-15T11:12:07Z routing: cohort_shift detected service=token-service shard=4 old=0.08 new=0.31
2026-04-15T11:12:09Z quotamgr: deny user=usr-88 reason=route_quota_exceeded route=gen-19
2026-04-15T11:12:12Z proxy: upstream 502 route=gen-19
```

deploy-bot: automated: applied rollout r-1150 -> 20% cohorts (agent=v3.1.0) by @Kira :rocket:

Owen: dashboards show p95 +150ms, errors +0.6% (soft gate=0.5%). Impact concentrated on token-service partitions 4/8.

Tess: likely hash input changed (new scope field). We need a preserve_hash flag for existing rollouts so assignments don't remap mid-flight.

Ravi: agree. Also propose a preflight API that does dry_run and returns `cohort_shift_rate` + per-route traffic delta. Block applies if shift_rate>0.02 or flap_count>4 in 10m.

Kira: example lightweight payload for the API (dry_run):

Kira: ```json
{"rollout_id":"r-1150","selector":"stable-hash(header.user_id,\"v3salt\")","dry_run":true,"flap_limit":4,"metrics_gates":["p95_latency","error_rate"],"gate_window_secs":900}
```

Owen: UI change: add an "Apply preview" modal that shows predicted shard heatmap, cohort_shift_rate, and an estimated % of traffic that would move. Disable real apply if flap limit exceeded.

Tess: telemetry gating: require 25m of stable gates before expanding >25% -> 100%. Also add console alert when cohort_shift_rate > 0.01.

SRE-oncall: ops rolled r-1150 back to r-1149 at 2026-04-15T11:29:30Z after the spike. Opening incident ticket.

Kira: follow-up: I'll add a `stabilizer` middleware on the config apply endpoint to run preflight and return `stability_score` (0..1). Server will reject non-dry-run applies with score<0.9. Schedule daily cohort-stability reports for owners.

Ravi: I'll draft the API PR for dry_run semantics, `preserve_hash_vN` and storing `operator_id` + `apply_seq` so console can show undo/rollback buttons.

Owen: I'll start the console PR for the preview modal + banner showing live gate metrics (sampled 1/8 for traces).

deploy-bot: action: rollback to r-1149 initiated by @SRE-oncall at 2026-04-15T11:29:30Z.
